register.labelZh: SPLIT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: split away 和 split off 可以描述樹枝、石塊或小組從較大的整體分離。；在英式非正式英語中,split on somebody 可表示向老師或其他有權處理事情的人告發某人做錯事。；split up 可以表示兩人分手,也可以表示其他人令一段感情關係結束。；split up 可以描述人們分成較小組別,也可以描述工作、課堂和時間被分成較易處理的部分。
register.summaryEn: Split away and split off can describe a branch, piece of rock or group becoming separated from something larger. In informal British English, split on somebody describes telling a teacher or another person in authority that somebody has done something wrong. Split up can describe two people ending their relationship or another person causing the relationship to end. Split up can describe people forming smaller groups or work, lessons and time being divided into manageable sections.
